description: Multi-topic occupation query. sections is required: basic, visas, assessment, invitations, eoi, stateNomination, courses, labourAgreements. Loads only requested topics in parallel. EOI includes 189, 190 and 491; courses use the first 8 recommendations. For pagination or detailed topic filters use the standalone tools. Returns English prose for selected topics only, with identity, source links and explicit missing-data or failure explanations. Uses no business JSON or structured numeric copy. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

name: get_occupation
title: Get selected occupation topics
